lines.en: What is the writer's carpet made of?
lines.cn: 作者的“地毯”（这里可能指作者的办公环境或工作场所）是由什么材料制成的呢？

lines.en: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning.
lines.cn: 我们刚搬进了一栋新房子，我一整个早上都在努力工作。

lines.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
lines.cn: 我一直在努力把我的新房间整理得井井有条。

lines.en: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
lines.cn: 这并不容易，因为我有超过一千本书。

lines.en: so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
lines.cn: 所以我暂时把我的书放在了地板上。

lines.en: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space
lines.cn: 目前，它们已经覆盖了每一寸的地面空间。

lines.en: and I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
lines.cn: 实际上，我必须踩在这些东西上才能进入或离开房间。

lines.en: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
lines.cn: 不久前，我的姐姐帮我把其中一个旧书柜搬上了楼梯。

lines.en: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
lines.cn: 她走进我的房间，看到地板上堆满了书，顿时感到非常惊讶。

lines.en: 'This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen,' she said.
lines.cn: “这是我见过最漂亮的地毯了，”她说。

lines.en: She gazed at it for some time then added,
lines.cn: 她凝视着它一会儿，然后补充道：

lines.en: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!'
lines.cn: 你可以在空闲时间坐在这里，直接在地毯上阅读！”
